scope: Synthetic development fixtures only; no source-bound n83 LFD result

encoding.json: UTF-8; field elements and targets are canonical decimal strings; counts are JSON integers
encoding.weights: Local last-block selector order z_0 through z_(ell-1); normalized selector relation z_i^2 = w_i z_i
encoding.pairing: Coefficient of all last-block selectors in H times the U^2 coefficient, reduced by square-zero relations
encoding.coefficient_sha256: SHA256 of canonical N83PFF1 bytes for C=A2-2tA1+t^2H; codec is src/prime_terminal_math.rs and documented in PRIME_FIRST_FALL_FORMAT.json

files.small-pairings.json: 12 fixtures: ell3,5,7 crossed with p101,1009 and a nonzero/zero delta target; direct pairing checked against independent quadratic polynomial product
files.top-image-small.json: All homogeneous last-block monomial multipliers of degree r-1 checked for each ell3,5,7; not a complete filtered-space computation
files.n83-synthetic.json: Four fixtures: two fixed weight lists crossed with target7/exceptional target; no linkage to the 42 original case targets
files.test.log: Release test output including expected caught-panic negative controls and all inherited donor tests
files.summary.json: Development counts, source and executable identity, exact command and claim boundaries
files.source/: Archived Rust sources, Cargo package and lockfile, and the design written before controls
files.test-instrument: Archived exact executable used for native unit tests; replay with a fresh N83_FUNCTIONAL_DEV_OUT directory
files.manifest.json: Archive payload paths, lengths and SHA256 hashes; excludes itself

replay: Run the restored test-instrument with a fresh output directory, then compare the three arithmetic JSON files byte-for-byte. Store replay logs outside the sealed archive.
limitations: Source binding, complete filtered closure and the proposed syzygy-to-filtered bridge are not certified by these tests. Zero delta is inconclusive. No new LFD, regularity, solving-degree or elite-base advantage.
